desc:
[MOBILE + CONTROLLER SUPPORT IN DEVELOPMENT]
Mobile and controller support is still in early development. Keyboard and mouse is strongly recommended for the best experience.

A fractured dystopian world where past and future collide.
An open-world action RPG inspired by Soulslike combat and MMO progression systems, currently in active development.

Build your character through a wide range of classes, attributes, modifiers, and upgrades that define your playstyle. Every choice impacts combat, progression, and survival in a world built to punish mistakes.

*AT LEAST 3GB OF DEDICATED RAM IS RECOMMENDED FOR STABLE PERFORMANCE.
